Mental health changes after 4 months of weight loss treatment with the glucagon-like peptide-1 analogue liraglutide 3.0 mg. This observational study examined changes in mental health and wellbeing after 4-months liraglutide 3.0 mg treatment in patients with obesity and explored associations with weight loss. We included 98 patients with obesity treated with liraglutide 3.0 mg.
